questions.question: There are 3 students in a group. If the weight of any student is added to the average weight of the other two the sums received are 48 kg, 52 kg, and 59 kg. The average weight (in kg) of the three students is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The weight of any student is added to the average weight of the other two the sums received are 48 kg, 52 kg, and 59 kg.

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of all the values/Total number value

**Calculation:**

Let the weight (in kg) of the three students is x, y and z

According to the question:

[x + (y + z)/2] = 48

⇒ (2x + y + z) = 96 ----(1)

Again,

[y + (x + z)/2] = 52

⇒ (2y + x + z) = 104 ----(2)

Now, 

[z + (x + y)/2] = 59

⇒ (2z + x + y) = 118 ----(3)

Multiply by 2 in equation (1);

⇒ (2x + y + z) × 2 = 96 × 2

⇒ (4x + 2y + 2z) = 192 ----(4)

Now, Subtracting from equation(4) to equation(2):

[(4x + 2y + 2z) – (2y + x + z)] = (192 – 104)

⇒ [(4x + 2y + 2z – 2y – x – z)] = 88

⇒ (3x + z) = 88 ----(a)

Multiply by 2 in equation (3):

⇒ (2z + x + y) × 2 = 118 × 2

⇒ 4z + 2x + 2y = 236 ----(5)

Now, Subtracting from equation(5) to equation(2):

[(4z + 2x + 2y) – (2y + x + z)] = 236 – 104

⇒ x + 3z = 132 ----(b)

Multiply by 3 in equation (a):

⇒ (3x + z) × 3 = 88 × 3

⇒ (9x + 3z) = 264 ----(c)

Now, Subtracting from equation(c) to equation(b)

⇒ [(9x + 3z) – (x + 3z)] = 264 – 132 = 132

⇒ [9x + 3z – x – 3z] = 132

⇒ 8x = 132

⇒ x = 132/8 = 16.5

From equation (b):

⇒ (3x + z) = 88

⇒ (3 × 16.5 + z) = 88

⇒ 49.5 + z = 88

⇒ z = 88 – 49.5 = 38.5

Putting the value of x and z in equation(1):

(2 × 16.5 + y + 38.5) = 96

⇒ 33 + y + 38.5 = 96

⇒ y = (96 – 71.5) = 24.5

Average = (x + y + z)/3

⇒ (16.5 + 24.5 + 38.5)/3

⇒ 79.5/3 = 26.5

**∴ The average weight (in kg) of the three students is 26.5.**

questions.question: The speed of a boat downstream is 2.5 times its speed upstream. If the total time taken by the boat for going 15 km downstream and the same distance upstream is 4(2)/(3) hours, then what is the speed (in km/h) of the boat downstream?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of downstream to upstream speed = 2.5 : 1 = 5 : 2.

For equal distance, the time ratio is inversely proportional to the speed ratio = 2 : 5.

Total time = 2 + 5 = 7 units → 14/3 hours.

Time taken downstream (2 units) = (14/3) × (2/7) = 4/3 hours.

Downstream speed = Distance ÷ Time = 15 ÷ (4/3) = 11.25 = 11¹/₄ km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 11¹/₄ km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance downstream = 15 km

Total distance upstream = 15 km

Total time = 4²/₃ hours = 14/3 hours

Ratio of downstream speed to upstream speed = 2.5 : 1 = 5 : 2.

Let downstream speed = 5x and upstream speed = 2x.

**Formula Used:** Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cee0059c61ddbc8b4f8e82d442a966a82af008b97790e28104e69d16710ac64.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (15 ÷ 5x) + (15 ÷ 2x) = 14 / 3

⇒ (3 / x) + (7.5 / x) = 14 / 3

⇒ 10.5 / x = 14 / 3

⇒ x = (10.5 × 3) ÷ 14

⇒ x = 31.5 ÷ 14 = 2.25

⇒ Downstream speed = 5x = 5 × 2.25 = 11.25 km/h

⇒ 11.25 km/h = 11¹/₄ km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 11¹/₄ km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed of Boat and Stream

If the speed of a boat in still water is B and the speed of the stream is S, then Downstream Speed (D) = B + S and Upstream Speed (U) = B − S.

Calculating Individual Speeds

Speed of boat in still water (B) = (D + U) ÷ 2 and Speed of stream (S) = (D − U) ÷ 2.

Average Speed for Same Distance

If a boat travels the same distance upstream and downstream, the Average Speed = (2 × D × U) ÷ (D + U).

questions.question: The volume of cylinder of height 32 cm and base diameter 36 cm is equal to the volume of a cone of height 24 cm. The curved surface area (in cm²) of the cone is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A cylinder of height 32 cm and a base diameter of 36 cm has a volume equal to the cone of height 24 cm.

**Formula Used:**

The volume of the cylinder = πR²H, and the volume of the cone = 1/3(πR²H)

The curved surface area of the cone = πRL

Where L is the lateral height of the cone = √(R² + H²)

 and R, H is the radius and the height of the cylinder and cone

**Calculation:**

Let the radius of the cone be R. Now the volume of the cylinder is πR²H which is equal to 1/3(πR²H) of the cone

⇒ π(18)²×32 = 1/3(π×R²×24), R = 36 cm

Now the value of L will be given by the formula mentioned above

⇒ L = √(36² + 24²) (As R = 36 cm and H = 24 cm)

⇒ L =12√(9 + 4) = 12√13 cm

Now the curved surface area of the cone will be πRL

⇒ Curved surface area = π×36×12√13 = 432√13π

∴ The curved surface area of the cone is **432√13π**

questions.question: A dealer sells an article by allowing a 15% discount on its marked price and gains 12%. If the cost price of the article is increased by 10%, how much discount percentage should he allow now on the same marked price so as to earn the same percentage profit as before?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount = 15%

Gains = 12%

**Formula used:**

Discount % = (M.P – S.P)/M.P × 100

**Calculation:**

Let C.P of an article be 100 unit

⇒ For 12% profit S.P = 112 unit

15% discount on mark price

⇒ S.P = 85% = 112 unit

⇒ M.P = 100% = ?

⇒ M.P = (100 × 112)/85

⇒ M.P = 2240/17

If C.P increased by 10%

⇒ New C.P = 110 unit

⇒ For 12% profit new S.P = (110 × 112)/100

⇒ 616/5

Discount % = (M.P – S.P)/M.P × 100

⇒ (2240/17 – 616/5)/(2240/17) × 100

⇒ 6.5%

**∴ The discount percentage should be allowed now on the same marked price is 6.5%**
